Every study on disk when the lens architecture was adopted (02-Sep-2026) carries a typed blend or no lens record at all; each is allowed to fail while it waits its turn. The build breaks on a NEW study with no entry either way, or on a listed study whose record has appeared and is wrong. This list may only ever get SHORTER (--prune).  [03-Sep-2026, per instruction — the origin of the bear and the bull is declared in the study] assert_lens_design now requires the primary's published range to carry a range_basis: what was moved, between which values, on what evidence, and that the macro path stood still. Its FIRST RUN found three of the five re-issued names newly failing, and two of them fail on SUBSTANCE rather than on missing documentation: AMOC builds its bear and bull from 'five simultaneous driver moves — volume, margin, currency, COST OF CAPITAL and TERMINAL GROWTH', and ARCC from 'its own crux — THE DISCOUNT RATE AND THE TERMINAL GROWTH MOVED TOGETHER'. That is the growth-by-discount-rate grid the new rule prohibits: both dials carry the same terminal inflation under [R-MACRO-01], so the corners published as bear and bull are the two least coherent cells in the grid. ARCC's own note ends 'never a spread invented around the answer' — a cautious label attached to the construction it disclaims, which is [R-CAL-02]'s lesson exactly. EGCH's basis reads as a business judgement (its programme carried through in both reads) but does not say what was moved, so it is documentation rather than substance. NONE of the three is repaired here: a basis this session invented would be worth nothing, and rebuilding the range on business drivers moves delivered numbers. All three are fixed at their next re-issue, and the list may only SHORTEN.
